name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 3 No 25
preamble: Solve the clues and fit the solutions into the diagram jigsaw-wise, wherever they will go.

clue.text: Long, long time: the first one's not the same
County changing date for sleeper's frame
I make rozzer's (copper's) locum wild
Vacillate: their fruit's on last of child
Former stance for commentary or show
Disc: without some copper swiftly go
Novice (Oz)? No, trout from Emerald Isle
Three-act Ring turns thrice in lofty style
Workless view of lump on head at back
Left with chute, not pushed, and made attack
Out of kilter gown in days gone by
Home for beast is left to warm and dry
Who shares board with chaos at game's end?
Awfully nice in home is quite un-genned
Dental change from stubborn — stop up holes
King in Winter's Tale topped fox 'twixt poles
Which is Latin, is the calaboose
Which is French, makes quotes of rights from ewes
Parsimonious devil enters heaven
Cock bird as the share to church was given
Stir up tune lest riven by dissension
Worship is a period invention
Rouse for party when one's fed to worms
Add/subtract, in algebraic terms
Annually, almost; quondam, quick
Moses' wife in code with Harpo sick
